name: session_status
description: Read-only readiness check for unattended or monitor-less automation: Windows session id/console/remote state, lock, input desktop, cursor access, active displays and a small primary-monitor capture probe. Returns ready=false with blocker codes and advice (e.g. no-active-display -> optional virtual display driver; session-not-active -> RDP was disconnected). Never unlocks, reconnects or changes settings.

name: displays_list
description: Enumerate active Windows displays, including IDD virtual monitors. Returns connection-scoped display references, device names and physical desktop bounds. Re-list invalidates old display references. Does not install or enable a driver.

name: display_capture
description: Capture a real PNG from a selected physical or IDD virtual display without activating a window. Default is the full display. A supplied region uses global desktop physical pixels and must fit entirely inside it; at most 16 megapixels. Returns a screen-level capture_id for one click_at/pointer_move/drag/scroll (pass display, not target) within 60 seconds, with coordinates relative to this image; useful when a window refuses focus. New captures and other tool calls (except session_status and cursor_position) invalidate it.

name: window_to_display
description: Restore a minimized/maximized target, then move it 16 pixels inside a selected display and shrink it if needed. Uses real Win32 actions; returns previous and current geometry. Partial changes may remain if the app rejects resizing. Shared Windows focus/cursor; not a separate session.

name: windows_list
description: Enumerate visible Win32 windows. Optional filters: case-insensitive title substring, process executable name (e.g. notepad or notepad.exe), foreground only, titled only. Returns scoped target references with pid, process and class (null when unavailable); invalidates previous references.

name: window_control
description: Direct Win32 window state/geometry control. Close posts WM_CLOSE, which may prompt to save; no force kill. All actions validate original HWND/process/thread identity.

target.description: Session target from the latest windows_list. Re-list invalidates previous targets.

name: capture
description: Activate target and return its visible region on the selected display (default primary). PNG metadata uses Windows desktop physical pixels. Not offscreen rendering. Returns capture_id for one click_at/pointer_move/drag/scroll (pass target) within 60 seconds; coordinates for those tools are relative to this image. New captures and other tool calls (except session_status and cursor_position) invalidate it.

target.description: Session target from the latest windows_list. Re-list invalidates previous targets.

display.description: Display reference from the latest displays_list in this connection; re-list after topology changes. Omit to use the primary monitor.

name: locate
description: Activate target and find one template in its visible selected-display region (default primary). Returns desktop physical coordinates, possibly negative. Multiple/no matches fail. Exact and confidence are mutually exclusive.

target.description: Session target from the latest windows_list. Re-list invalidates previous targets.

display.description: Display reference from the latest displays_list in this connection; re-list after topology changes. Omit to use the primary monitor.

name: click_image
description: Recognize one image then recheck pixels, foreground and geometry before sending a real click. Inspect capture first; template must be distinctive.

target.description: Session target from the latest windows_list. Re-list invalidates previous targets.

display.description: Display reference from the latest displays_list in this connection; re-list after topology changes. Omit to use the primary monitor.

name: click_at
description: Send a real click (left/right/middle, 1-3 clicks) at an observed image point using a single-use proof from capture (pass target) or display_capture (pass display). Checks the proof binding, freshness, display, cursor, cancellation and exact pixels in a clipped 32x32 patch before input; window proofs also check target identity, foreground and bounds. Does not activate a lost-focus window. Every attempt consumes the proof. Hover/animation changes may require a fresh capture with the cursor positioned. Changes outside the patch and changes after the final check are not detected. Capture again to verify the result.

target.description: Window target of the latest capture. Supply exactly one of target or display, matching how the proof was taken.

display.description: Display reference of the latest display_capture. Supply exactly one of target or display.

capture_id.description: Unused capture_id returned by capture or display_capture in this connection, valid for 60 seconds.

x.description: Horizontal pixel in the captured PNG, relative to its left edge.

y.description: Vertical pixel in the captured PNG, relative to its top edge.

name: pointer_move
description: Move the real cursor to an observed image point (e.g. to reveal hover menus or tooltips) using a single-use proof from capture (pass target) or display_capture (pass display). Sends no button or wheel input. Checks the proof binding, freshness, display, cursor, cancellation and exact pixels in a clipped 32x32 patch before input; window proofs also check target identity, foreground and bounds. Does not activate a lost-focus window. Every attempt consumes the proof. Hover/animation changes may require a fresh capture with the cursor positioned. Changes outside the patch and changes after the final check are not detected. Capture again to verify the result.

target.description: Window target of the latest capture. Supply exactly one of target or display, matching how the proof was taken.

display.description: Display reference of the latest display_capture. Supply exactly one of target or display.

capture_id.description: Unused capture_id returned by capture or display_capture in this connection, valid for 60 seconds.

x.description: Horizontal pixel in the captured PNG, relative to its left edge.

y.description: Vertical pixel in the captured PNG, relative to its top edge.

name: drag
description: Press a mouse button at one observed image point, move to a second point of the same image and release, using a single-use proof from capture (pass target) or display_capture (pass display). Both points must lie inside the captured image (and window). The button is released on every error path. Checks the proof binding, freshness, display, cursor, cancellation and exact pixels in a clipped 32x32 patch before input; window proofs also check target identity, foreground and bounds. Does not activate a lost-focus window. Every attempt consumes the proof. Hover/animation changes may require a fresh capture with the cursor positioned. Changes outside the patch and changes after the final check are not detected. Capture again to verify the result.

target.description: Window target of the latest capture. Supply exactly one of target or display, matching how the proof was taken.

display.description: Display reference of the latest display_capture. Supply exactly one of target or display.

capture_id.description: Unused capture_id returned by capture or display_capture in this connection, valid for 60 seconds.

x.description: Start pixel, relative to the captured image left edge.

y.description: Start pixel, relative to the captured image top edge.

to_x.description: End pixel, relative to the captured image left edge.

to_y.description: End pixel, relative to the captured image top edge.

duration_ms.description: Movement time while the button is held.

name: scroll
description: Send wheel input at an observed image point using a single-use proof from capture (pass target) or display_capture (pass display). Checks the proof binding, freshness, display, cursor, cancellation and exact pixels in a clipped 32x32 patch before input; window proofs also check target identity, foreground and bounds. Does not activate a lost-focus window. Every attempt consumes the proof. Hover/animation changes may require a fresh capture with the cursor positioned. Changes outside the patch and changes after the final check are not detected. Capture again to verify the result.

target.description: Window target of the latest capture. Supply exactly one of target or display, matching how the proof was taken.

display.description: Display reference of the latest display_capture. Supply exactly one of target or display.

capture_id.description: Unused capture_id returned by capture or display_capture in this connection, valid for 60 seconds.

x.description: Horizontal pixel in the captured PNG, relative to its left edge.

y.description: Vertical pixel in the captured PNG, relative to its top edge.

clicks.description: Nonzero wheel steps: positive up, negative down; horizontal positive right, negative left.

name: cursor_position
description: Read-only: return the current cursor position in Windows desktop physical pixels (origin at primary top-left). Does not consume or invalidate a capture proof.

name: window_wait
description: Poll every 100 ms until windows matching title and/or process are present, absent, or in the foreground, up to timeout. Cancellable. On success returns the matching windows as fresh targets (like windows_list) and invalidates previous targets; on timeout fails without changing targets.

name: app_launch
description: Start a local program directly (no shell): absolute path to an existing .exe only (.cmd/.bat/.ps1/.lnk rejected), up to 32 literal arguments, optional absolute cwd. Disabled unless the MCP server was started with AUTOGUI_ALLOW_LAUNCH=1. Returns the pid without waiting for exit; with wait_title it also waits for a matching window and returns fresh targets.

wait_title.description: Wait for a window whose title contains this text

name: type_text
description: Activate target and send Unicode text to the focused control, in batches of at most 32 Unicode scalar values. Rechecks foreground and cancellation before every batch; preserves per-character fail-safe checks. Partial text (up to one batch after focus changes) may be sent before cancellation/failure.

target.description: Session target from the latest windows_list. Re-list invalidates previous targets.

text.description: Text to enter; no shell evaluation

name: hotkey
description: Validate key names, then activate target and send a chord, releasing all keys afterwards (e.g. [ctrl,a] or [enter]); presses repeats it, rechecking foreground and cancellation each time. Unknown keys fail before focus changes. Verify the focused control before input.

target.description: Session target from the latest windows_list. Re-list invalidates previous targets.

name: screensaver
description: Read screensaver status, pause auto-start, resume or stop an active .scr saver. Pause restores on timer, resume or MCP disconnection. Does not unlock Windows or change password/lock policy.
